test_title: PYST 126: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24 Jan, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some beans are potatoes.

All carrots are potatoes.

All gourds are potatoes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gourds are beans.

II. Some carrots are gourds.

III. Some potatoes are gourds.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

solution:
Statements:

Some beans are potatoes.

All carrots are potatoes.

All gourds are potatoes.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83d80d0fd12bc430d1e9b310df3089c6b877c1696aa7088ac75994aa1a203c4a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some gourds are beans. → **not follow** (Because there is no definite relation given between gourds and beans, so it can be possible only but not definitely true)

II. Some carrots are gourds. → **not follow** (Because there is no definite relation given between carrots and gourds, so it can be possible only but not definitely true)

III. Some potatoes are gourds. →** Follow **(All gourds are potatoes, which means some potatoes are gourds definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion III follows".**
